sloka: यद् अंतरम् वायस वैनतेययोःयद् अंतरम् मद्गु मयूरयोः अपि ।यद् अंतरम् हंस गृध्रयोः वनेतद् अंतरम् दाशरथेः तव एव च ॥३-४७-४७॥
transliteration: yad aṁtaram vāyasa vainateyayoḥyad aṁtaram madgu mayūrayoḥ api ।yad aṁtaram haṁsa gṛdhrayoḥ vanetad aṁtaram dāśaratheḥ tava eva ca ॥3-47-47॥

translations.english: The difference between you and Dasaratha's son is the difference between a crow and Garuda, a watercrane and a peacock, a vulture and a swan in the forest.
